items.name: SCU VI: Big Feast 2026

venue.name: Santa Clara University
venue.address: 500 El Camino Real, Santa Clara, CA 95053
venue.details: Sobrato Campus for Discovery and Innovation (SCDI Building, 3rd Floor, Rooms 3301 & 3302)

items.information:
This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

- Current SCU students may register for a reduced fee of $3.00 by sending Professor Marks (rmarks@scu.edu) an email from their @scu.edu account prior to registering with this site.
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no more than 20 minutes early, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*

items.name: Thankscubing Quiet NY 2026

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

items.information:
This competition only has the blindfolded events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [this one](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ThankscubingNY2026).

To maintain a quiet environment, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest during the competition.
The Harry & Thelma Adler community room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.
